title: Where Ellie really came from in The Last of Us
subject: ellie
description:
Would you have trusted Marlene with Ellie? 👇

Ellie's life before Joel: Boston, the Fireflies and one night in a mall. Spoilers for The Last of Us Part I and Left Behind.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Naughty Dog or Sony Interactive Entertainment. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Ellie never knew her mother, Anna.
Anna died soon after Ellie was born in 2019. Marlene, leader of the Fireflies, promised to watch over her.
Ellie grew up in a FEDRA military boarding school in the Boston quarantine zone.
At fourteen, her best friend Riley Abel came back after weeks away, wearing a Firefly pendant.
That night they snuck into the Liberty Gardens Mall. Infected found them, and both girls were bitten.
Riley didn't make it. Ellie waited for the fever, and it never came.
Three weeks later, Marlene handed her to a smuggler named Joel.
